label: v232
changes: Household now has a Keys, locks & the safe section — the things a locksmith actually asks for when you're standing outside your own front door.

The security-card number is the one that matters: no locksmith will cut a copy of a security key without it, and it lives on a card in a drawer nobody can find at 11pm. Same for a safe — make and serial is what opens one you've lost the key to.
Also there: the lock make, who has a spare key, and your alarm company and its code.

The card number, safe serial and alarm code are encrypted the same way the door code and Wi-Fi password already were, and are never sent to the assistant. The lock make, safe make, alarm company and who-has-a-spare stay readable, so the assistant can still answer “what locks do we have?”
You can tell the assistant any of it, or photograph the card and let it read the number off. Your locksmith's own phone number goes with the plumber and electrician, under Important info.
